paragraphs: He reports Rav: Berakhot 12a and 12b, five times.[^1]

notes.text: Five stored Davidson scalars were read: two in Berakhot 12a and three in 12b, each reporting Rabbah bar Chinena in Rav’s name. They support the five cited reports; this is not an exhaustive independent search for additional occurrences. Elder translates סבא; one saved scalar brackets that word. Rav is explicit, and no personal rank is added to Rabbah or Chinena.
